newsitem.title: CHINA: Latest state debt issue selling well in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Latest state debt issue selling well in Shanghai.

text.p: The latest batch of state treasury notes was selling well in Shanghai with over 50 percent of the planned amount for the city sold since the issue opened on March 1, the China Securities newspaper said on Tuesday.
A total of 4.525 billion yuan of the debt has been sold so far, compared with a total allotment of 8.648 billion, the newspaper said. The issue period is scheduled to end on October 20, it said.
China's Finance Ministry is issuing the latest batch of 123 billion yuan in two-, three- and five-year treasury notes through major banks, securities houses and trust and investment companies.
